_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Odwumayɛni {player_id}, wɔreyɛ {num_rounds} afei wɔ Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Wo wɔ $ {pool} sika a wɔbɛkyɛ no mu wɔ afei yi mu wɔ wo ne Odwumayɛni {other_id}.

Odwumayɛni a ɔreyɛ nhyehyɛe:
  - Yɛ nhyehyɛe: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Sɛ wɔgye tom → Wo bɛnya $(pool - X), odwumayɛni foforo no bɛnya $X
  - Sɛ wɔmpɛ → Wo nyinaa bɛnya $0
  - Nhwehwɛmu: [Offer: $3]  anaa  'Mewɔ deda sɛ ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. [Offer: $5]'

Odwumayɛni a ɔreyɛ nkontɛm:
  - Yɛ nkontɛm wɔ nhyehyɛe no so sɛ [Accept] anaa [Reject]
  - Nhwehwɛmu: 'Ɛte sɛ ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. [Accept]'
            'Ɛnyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ koraa. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Ɔnkyerɛw {round_number} hyɛ ase! ---
Odwumayɛni {proposer_id} ne odwumayɛni a ɔdeɛ adeɛ, Odwumayɛni {responder_id} ne odwumayɛni a ɔgyeɛ adeɛ.
round.offer: Afei {round_number}: Odwumayɛni {proposer_id} de $ {offer} bɛma Odwumayɛni {responder_id} (de $ {keep} bɛkora).
round.accepted: Odwumayɛni {responder_id} gye tom! Afei {round_number} nyinaa: Odwumayɛni {proposer_id} +$ {proposer_gain}, Odwumayɛni {responder_id} +$ {responder_gain}. Nyinaa foforo: Odwumayɛni 0: $ {total_0}, Odwumayɛni 1: $ {total_1}.
round.rejected: Odwumayɛni {responder_id} ampene adeɛ a wɔdeɛ baa! Ɔnkyerɛw {round_number} nyaa: Odwumayɛni baanu +$0. Nneɛma dodow no ara ne: Odwumayɛni 0: ${total_0}, Odwumayɛni 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Ɔkyerɛwfo no de [Offer: $X] a ne din wɔ ase yi na ɛbɔ n'afotu.
invalid_move.bad_integer: Ɛho hia sɛ wɔhyɛ no bɔ.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ɛwɔ sɛ ɛka no yɛ $0 ne ${pool} ntam.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Mprempren no, yɛnni hokwan biara sɛ yɛbɛma mmuae.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder bui sɛ ɔ[Accept] anaa [Reject] ahɔde no.

outcome.win: Ɔkandifo {winner} dii nkonim kyɛn ${winner_total} abɔde kyɛn Ɔkandifo {loser} ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Wɔbɔɔ so! Asɛnnifo no nyinaa de ${total} na ewiee.
